problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 5 \\ -2 & 0 & 5 \\ 2 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & -1 & 5\end{aligned}],\,B={[\begin{aligned}| \\ \frac{{a}_{1}}{‖{a}_{1}‖} \\ |\end{aligned}]\,,[\begin{aligned}| \\ \frac{{a}_{2}}{‖{a}_{2}‖} \\ |\end{aligned}]\,,[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c \\ d\end{aligned}]}
$$

Consider the subspace $V=\text{Col}(A)$ spanned by the columns ${a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}$ of the matrix $A,$ and an **orthonormal** basis $B$ of $\text{Col}(A),$ shown above. Given that ${a}_{1}⊥{a}_{2},$ and that $B$ is derived from $V$ using the Gram-Schmidt process, what is the value of $|\,a\,|?$
worked_solution:
Since the first two vectors are already orthogonal, we proceed to find an orthogonal basis using the Gram-Schmidt process.

**Step 1**: We set ${v}_{1}={a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

**Step 2**: We set ${v}_{2}={a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$

**Step 3**. Next, we find ${v}_{3}$ using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{3} & ={a}_{3}-{\text{proj}}_{{v}_{1}}\,{a}_{3}-{\text{proj}}_{{v}_{2}}\,{a}_{3} \\  & ={a}_{3}-\frac{{a}_{3}\cdot {v}_{1}}{{v}_{1}\cdot {v}_{1}}{v}_{1}-\frac{{a}_{3}\cdot {v}_{2}}{{v}_{2}\cdot {v}_{2}}{v}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the formula for ${v}_{3}$ in our case gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{3} & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 5 \\ -5 \\ 5\end{aligned}]-(-\frac{10}{10})[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-(\frac{0}{2})[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 5 \\ -5 \\ 5\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-0[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 3 \\ -3 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we normalize ${v}_{3}$ dividing it by $‖{v}_{3}‖=3\sqrt{10}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{u}_{3} & =\frac{{v}_{3}}{‖{v}_{3}‖}=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{10}}[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 3 \\ -3 \\ 6\end{aligned}]=\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{10}}{5} \\ \frac{\sqrt{10}}{10} \\ -\frac{\sqrt{10}}{10} \\ \frac{\sqrt{10}}{5}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, $|\,a\,|=\frac{\sqrt{10}}{5}.$
